rationale: Return a complete script while spending a small amount of remaining export budget on the penultimate reverse-tail value projection. The current best already preserves recurrent-tail Q/K and the final-block V path; adding block 7 c_v keeps the proven staged reverse-tail recurrence, training loop, and final exact int8+zlib evaluation intact, but gives the earlier recurrent pass a less lossy value path after export. This is a compact export-budget reallocation rather than another scalar sweep.
title: Full-Script Penultimate Recurrent V FP16 Rescue
